name: Puducherry
scopeLimits: Official Puducherry sources document the Nilamagal land-record query and FMB/village-map services. The Nilamagal form requires region, taluk, revenue village and Patta or re-survey number. No survey identifier or point-to-village match was established, so no parcel-specific query or geometry request was made.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Puducherry Directorate of Survey, Settlement and Land Records issues settlement extracts, FMB copies and village maps, and runs Nilamagal land-record services across the Union Territory. These are official local survey and record services; they do not provide anonymous polygon coverage for this WUP locator. The official contact directory explicitly locates the Survey and Land Records Director’s office in New Saram, Puducherry, providing city-local institutional evidence.
technicalBlocker: The official record service requires a survey/Patta identifier and village context; no safe anonymous polygon feature endpoint was identified.
remainingUncertainty: Exact revenue village and survey number for the WUP point; whether FMB/village-map copies can be accessed in a schema-safe digital geometry format.
nextStep: Resolve the WUP point to a revenue village and survey number using an official map index, then assess whether the public output is a full polygon source or only a document copy.
